status: Prospective methods frozen before this execution; original datasets and earlier aggregate results already inspected. No retrospective blinded claim.
samples: C25 199 G11 with original Gupta2011 light-curve columns
Park published quality cuts on those original columns
Pantheon matched unique physical-SN G11-first and R19-first, .06<zHD<.42
ledger: Signed correction identity, exact row indices, no regenerated correction declared physical.
fixed_age_gls_models: intercept + age + z + host mass + c + x1
eiv: Normal latent-age population, full frozen STAT+SYS covariance; joint mean-age regression on z/mass/c/x1; free residual scatter. Gaussian posterior summaries are a sensitivity model.
young_host: 2000 paired whole-SN bootstrap replicates with fold identity preserved
linear-operator exact induced covariance conditional on fixed ages and available original diagonal errors

prediction.covariance: Full released covariance including train/test block; conditional Gaussian test score; fixed measured ages, no age error model or training-data independence claim.
prediction.report: Per-physical-SN mean paired squared-loss gain and block joint log-score; repeated split scores are dependent.

overlap: Fixed bins [.06,.15,.25,.35,.42], fixed 4 Gyr young threshold; continuous-mass/redshift/colour/width residualized age information.
interpretation: Incremental prediction, not causal age or progenitor slope. Raw Tripp nuisance refit uses frozen released distance covariance and corrections; it is conditional accounting, not a full survey re-fit.

changes: 5000 correlated-noise conditional null and power draws for the already specified repeated-fold prediction statistic
same original G11 sample with original and C25-updated ages
amendment_after_initial_results.status: Added after initial outcomes; exploratory sensitivity and validation, not preregistered confirmatory tests. Uses the same seeds and primary models.
